author: you
description: Scans messages with a local AI model for safety-relevant content (sexual, hate, violence, harassment, self-harm) and reports or auto-acts based on configurable thresholds.
install_msg: Thanks for installing! Run `[p]load moderationcog` then `[p]modai enable` and `[p]modai channel #your-report-channel` to get started. Note: `transformers` and `torch` must be installed in Red's environment first (see README).
short: Local-AI message moderation with soft/hard thresholds.
